description: Pose references for template7-shoulder (item 5 / pass 3d-1 item 4): the generated drawings in pose-reference-01/output, same 1086x1448 frame as the rig canvas. Body alignment pivots (midline, chin, crotch) are measured from each image by `animator ref-compare` and written to its report; the arm pivots below (canvas px of the reference image, the viewer-left arm = the rig's arm) are hand-marked on a 50 px grid (the shoulder pivot is not visible in a drawing: it stays at the rig pivot unless the drawing lifts the shoulder, as in shrug) and drive the rig pose (raise from the upper-arm direction, elbow from the forearm, shrug from the clavicle base to the shoulder pivot), clamped to the bone limits.

references.name: both-arms-up
references.note: both arms raised; the rig has the viewer-left arm only, so only that side is compared

references.name: shrug
references.note: the drawing lifts the shoulder ~50 canvas px (about 40 degrees of clavicle); the rig shrug limit is 12

references.name: elbow-bent-90
references.note: the drawn forearm bends ~99 degrees; the rig elbow is capped at 70 (pose limit)
